\caption{Degrees of freedom (in thousands) of diffused Nitsche (three per free node of the trimmed octree) and of the three body-fitted P1 meshes (three per vertex) at octree depth 8. Matched DOFs: vertex count targeted at the octree's node count (secant search, closest of up to six trials kept); matched surface: surface edge length $h_{\min}$; graded: $h_{\min}$ at the surface, coarser inside like the octree. Flags, at the session's $h_{\min}$: T, wall thinner than $4h_{\min}$; G, gaps narrower than $h_{\min}$ on over 1\% of the surface; L, a load within $3h_{\min}$ of a support; S, a support piece below $50h_{\min}^2$ or a partial clamp on a section thinner than $4h_{\min}$; blank, unflagged. ---, no body-fitted mesh (the input surface self-intersects). Medians over all objects and over the unflagged ones; $n$, number of values. Details in Section~S\ref{si:error-comparison}.}\label{tab:si-bf-dofs-d8}
